frameworks.title: Tones change meaning
frameworks.body: Mā (mother), má (hemp), mǎ (horse), mà (scold). Same syllable, four meanings. Tones aren't optional — they're the word.

frameworks.title: No verb conjugation
frameworks.body: Verbs don't change for tense or person. Time is shown with words like 昨天 (yesterday) or 了 (past marker).

frameworks.title: Measure words
frameworks.body: You can't say 'three book' — you need a measure word: 三本书 (three [volume] books).
